fields.project_purpose: Modernize enterprise enterprise resource planning core infrastructure into unified cloud platform.
fields.high_level_project_description: Implement automated financial, procurement, and supply chain modules with real-time analytics across all regional operating branches.
fields.project_boundaries: Excludes legacy mainframe decomissioning which is managed under Program Wave 2.
high_level_requirements: Full compliance with National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) regulations
Dual-language UI supporting Arabic and English
fields.high_level_assumptions_and_constraints: Core database schemas remain accessible throughout migration window; budget capped at pre-approved ceiling.

85% of standard purchase requests processed without manual intervention.

fields.project_exit_criteria: All core ERP services active in production with zero Severity-1 defect tickets open for 14 consecutive days.
fields.project_approval_requirements: Signed authorization by Project Sponsor and PMO Steering Committee at Gate 0.
